skills/ui-quality: text on a surface clears 4.5:1; use the color
Button / danger / compact covers a destructive action in a bar
and measures 7.2:1. The agent wrote a local color instead.
In BulkActionBar, replace the local color on Delete with
Button variant="danger" size="compact". Do not add a color
to BulkActionBar.css; the token layer has the pair.
Delete is outlined. Opens the full preview on click.
The table had no way to act on more than one row.
I added a BulkActionBar that appears when any row
is checked, reused Button and Checkbox, and gave
Checkbox an indeterminate state for the header.
